news.title: Haley Stevens Goes on Attack Against Abdul El-Sayed at Michigan Senate Debate
news.summary: At their first one-on-one debate in a top Senate race, Representative Haley Stevens accused her progressive rival, Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, of being too focused on publicity as he called her a tool of corporate interests.
